authority: This registry is the single source of truth for locally qualified FFF process compensation values. Only a value whose state is QUALIFIED may be used in a design. UNQUALIFIED means no local measurement exists for that process identity: the design must print the named coupon and record the outcome as a benchmark-measurement before committing to a number. The absence of a value is never evidence that no compensation is needed, and a value qualified on one machine/material/nozzle/profile identity does not transfer to another.

requested_scope.slicer_profile: Anycubic Slicer Next workspace reference profile

required_action: Print the named coupon on this exact process, record the outcome as a benchmark-measurement under libraries/3d-learning/benchmarks/measurements/, and update the registry. Until then no value may be assumed.
